name: Google Search Extract
description: Search Google and extract top 5 result titles + URLs
task: Go to https://www.google.com, search for 'latest AI research 2024', then extract the title and URL of the top 5 organic search results

name: Scrape Book Store
description: Extract all books with prices from toscrape.com
task: Go to https://books.toscrape.com, extract all book titles and their prices from the first page, then report the 3 most expensive books

name: Form Fill Demo
description: Fill a demo contact form automatically
task: Go to https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html, fill in the text input with 'Hello World', select 'One' from the dropdown, check the checkbox, then take a screenshot

name: Wikipedia Research
task: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence, extract the first 3 paragraphs of the article and the names of all sections in the table of contents

name: Hacker News Top Stories
description: Extract top stories from Hacker News
task: Go to https://news.ycombinator.com, extract the top 10 story titles along with their point counts and comment counts

name: GitHub Trending
task: Navigate to https://github.com/trending, extract the names, descriptions, and star counts of the top 5 trending repositories today

name: Screenshot & Describe
description: Visit a page, screenshot it, and describe the layout
task: Go to https://example.com, take a screenshot, and describe what you see on the page including any links and text content

name: DuckDuckGo Search
description: Search DuckDuckGo (no tracking) and extract results
task: Go to https://duckduckgo.com, search for 'Node.js best practices 2024', and extract the titles and URLs of the first 5 results
